# Jaipur Eye & Dental Hospital (JEDH)

> Jaipur Eye & Dental Hospital (JEDH) is a comprehensive eye and dental care hospital in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, operating since 2017. Led by MS and MDS qualified specialists, JEDH has treated 20,000+ patients with a 4.8-star Google rating.

## About

JEDH provides specialized ophthalmology and dentistry services under one roof. The hospital is led by Dr. Amit Gupta (MS Ophthalmology, Medical Director) and Dr. Nehal Gupta (MDS Prosthodontics, Senior Dental Surgeon). The team includes 6 specialist doctors covering cataract surgery, LASIK, glaucoma, retina care, dental implants, Invisalign, cosmetic dentistry, and oral surgery.

## Location & Contact

- Address: Plot No. 1, Near Vidhan Sabha, Lalkothi, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302015, India

- Website: https://jaipureyedental.com

## Eye Care Services

- Cataract Surgery: Phaco & Femto procedures with premium IOL options (Monofocal, Toric, Multifocal, EDOF). From ₹18,000/eye.
- LASIK/PRK: Bladeless Femto LASIK, PRK/TransPRK, and Contoura Vision topography-guided LASIK. From ₹35,000/eye.
- Glaucoma Treatment: Medical management, laser therapy, and surgical options.
- Retina Care: Diabetic retinopathy, retinal detachment, macular disorders. Intravitreal injections and laser treatment.
- Pediatric Eye Care: Myopia control, amblyopia treatment, pediatric eye exams.

## Dental Care Services

- Dental Implants: Korean and German (premium/elite) implant systems with 3D CBCT scanning. From ₹25,000/tooth.
- Invisalign: Lite and Comprehensive clear aligner treatments. Certified Invisalign provider.
- Cosmetic Dentistry: Teeth whitening, porcelain veneers, smile makeovers.
- Orthodontics: Metal braces, ceramic braces, Invisalign.
- Preventive Care: Dental cleanings, fluoride treatments, oral health assessments.
- Oral Surgery: Wisdom tooth extraction, jaw surgery.

All pricing is transparent and published at https://jaipureyedental.com/pricing.html

### Eye Care
- Cataract Surgery (Indian IOL): ₹18,000 - ₹25,000/eye
- Cataract Surgery (Imported IOL): ₹30,000 - ₹45,000/eye
- Cataract Surgery (Multifocal IOL): ₹55,000 - ₹75,000/eye
- Cataract Surgery (Toric IOL): ₹65,000 - ₹85,000/eye

- LASIK Contoura Vision: ₹55,000 - ₹70,000/eye
- PRK/TransPRK: ₹40,000 - ₹55,000/eye
